expected_behavior: The conversation is compacted into a handoff brief of exactly the seven named sections — Do next, Where this stands, Settled, Open, Suggested skills, Sources — rather than a summary that leaves the next agent to re-derive state.
Settled decisions each carry their one-line reason, so the next agent does not re-litigate them.
The brief points at the artifacts that already hold detail (specs, plans, task files, ADRs, commits) instead of duplicating their content.
